newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-BHP to cut dividend plan discounts.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-BHP to cut dividend plan discounts.

text.p: Steel, minerals and energy giant The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd said on Friday it would reduce the discount available under its dividend investment plan and bonus share plan to 2.5 percent from five percent, effective June 1997.
Shareholders who wished to alter their participation would need to advise the company prior to the declaration of that dividend, expected to be on March 21, 1997.
BHP said the discount applicable to the employee share plan would be similarly reduced.
The decision to reduce the discount was in line with current market trends, the company said.
